documents.title: Quarry Immunology reports progress with Xanamab (synthetic press release)
documents.text: Quarry Immunology today announced dosing in a Phase 2 study of Xanamab. Xanamab is a monoclonal antibody targeting TL1A for moderate-to-severe ulcerative colitis. The company did not comment on partnering.

documents.title: Registry update for Bralimab (synthetic)
documents.text: The sponsor lists Bralimab in an ongoing Phase 2 induction study in Crohn's disease.

documents.title: Halden Therapeutics signs regional deal for Goramab (synthetic)
documents.text: Halden Therapeutics granted Large Pharma B (synthetic) exclusive licensed U.S. rights to Goramab in September 2026.
